metadata.question: Was there only snow and no clouds present in the Northern Tablelands in New South Wales, Australia on August 2, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Northern Tablelands, New South Wales, Australia (approximately -30.5°S, 151.5°E) - Date: August 2, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for cloud and snow detection (good spatial resolution) - Need to check for both snow presence and cloud presence 2. Masking strategy: - This question asks specifically about clouds vs snow, so I should NOT mask clouds - I need to detect both clouds and snow separately - Use SCL (Scene Classification Layer) band from Sentinel-2 which classifies pixels including snow/ice (class 11) and clouds (classes 8, 9, 10) 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: If there are snow pixels but NO cloud pixels → Answer A - If there are clouds present (regardless of snow) → Answer B - If no images found → C1 - If images exist but no valid pixels after processing → C2 - If calculation fails → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Northern Tablelands, NSW, Australia const geometry = ee.Geometry.Point([151.5, -30.5]).buffer(50000); // 50km radius // 2. Define date range const startDate = '2025-08-02'; const endDate = '2025-08-03'; console.log('Searching for Sentinel-2 images...'); // 3. Load Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance with SCL band let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const imageCount = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 images found for the specified date and location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Use the first available image const image = collection.first(); const scl = image.select('SCL'); // 5. Define pixel classifications // SCL classes: 8=Cloud medium probability, 9=Cloud high probability, 10=Thin cirrus, 11=Snow/Ice const snowMask = scl.eq(11); const cloudMask = scl.eq(8).or(scl.eq(9)).or(scl.eq(10)); // 6. Count pixels const snowCount = await snowMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SCL').getInfo(); const cloudCount = await cloudMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SCL').getInfo(); const totalPixels = await scl.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SCL').getInfo(); console.log(`Total pixels analyzed: ${totalPixels}`); console.log(`Snow pixels: ${snowCount}`); console.log(`Cloud pixels: ${cloudCount}`); // 7. Validation if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in the analysis area.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (snowCount === null || cloudCount === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null values returned.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Determine answer if (snowCount > 0 && cloudCount === 0) { console.log('Result: Snow present, no clouds detected.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Result: Clouds present (${cloudCount} pixels) or no snow (${snowCount} pixels).`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
